items.h: Sequential Read Speed: Up to 560 MB/s
Sequential Write Speed: Up to 280 MB/s

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel D3-S4510 240GB Enterprise SSD is engineered for data centers, enterprise servers, and professional IT environments requiring high reliability and consistent performance. Featuring advanced 3D NAND TLC technology, this SSD delivers optimized read-intensive performance with enhanced endurance and reduced power consumption.


Equipped with a SATA III 6Gb/s interface, the drive offers fast data transfer speeds of up to 560MB/s read and 280MB/s write. It also includes enterprise-level features such as end-to-end data protection, power-loss protection, and AES 256-bit encryption to ensure maximum data integrity and security.


Ideal for server upgrades, cloud storage, virtualization, and RAID configurations, the Intel D3-S4510 ensures stable and efficient storage performance in demanding workloads across Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • 240GB enterprise-grade SSD for server and data center use
  • 2.5-inch 7mm SATA III (6Gb/s) interface
  • Up to 560MB/s read and 280MB/s write speed
  • 3D TLC NAND for reliability and efficiency
  • End-to-end data protection for data integrity
  • Power-loss protection to prevent data corruption
  • AES 256-bit hardware encryption
  • Low power consumption and optimized performance
  • High endurance for read-intensive workloads
